title: Tanzanian Grilled Squid
community: Zanzibar beach restaurants and night markets
author: Chef Jabir
desc: Tanzanian Grilled Squid — whole squid scored and marinated in lemon, garlic, and Zanzibar spices, grilled over charcoal in 6—8 minutes. The beach restaurant favourite — simple, fast, and magnificent when the squid is this fresh.
longDesc: Grilled squid is the Zanzibar beach restaurant starter everyone orders — whole squid, marinated briefly, grilled quickly over high charcoal. When fresh from the morning's catch and coals at peak, it needs only lemon and pili pili.
ingredients: 600g whole fresh squid — cleaned, tentacles separated
Pili pili sauce and lemon wedges to serve
steps: Score squid tubes in a crosshatch pattern — cuts about 5mm deep.
Combine marinade. Coat squid. Marinate 30 minutes.
Grill over very high heat for 3—4 minutes per side.
The squid curls and chars slightly — this is correct.
Serve immediately with pili pili and lemon.
chefTips: Scoring allows even cooking and decorative curl.
Fresh squid is sweet; frozen is rubbery — enormous difference.
cookingScience: Scored squid tubes curl towards the scored side when hit with high heat — scored muscle fibres contract faster, creating the characteristic curl. Increases surface area for Maillard browning.
sustainabilityTips: Fresh Indian Ocean squid from local Zanzibar fishermen.
culturalNote: Grilled squid at a Zanzibar beach restaurant — fresh from the sea, cooked in minutes, eaten with cold drinks and the sound of the ocean.
